name: Akikaze no Love Songs
original_name: 秋風のラヴ・ソングス
source:
It's autumn, and main character is busy staging a play for culture festival. He tries to find important things in everyday life and build memories with important people.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
秋天到了，主角正忙着为文化祭排演戏剧。他试着在日常生活中寻找重要的事物，与重要的人共同留下回忆。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
